specs.subject: Backend-state verification for agents
specs.composition: A forensic split-screen architecture: an upper claim channel and a lower durable-state channel with database records, side-effect receipts and repeated-run samples converging on a verification tribunal, then an immutable evidence ledger.

specs.subject: API-driven Copilot code review with adjustable effort
specs.composition: A repository change enters a review API router; three calibrated inspection depths fan through code, security and test analyzers, then reconverge into evidence-backed review comments and a merge decision.

specs.subject: Synchronized cross-app knowledge work
specs.composition: A shared data spine feeds three differentiated work surfaces—object-level image editing, an interactive spreadsheet canvas and cross-app task execution—while provenance and synchronization rails maintain consistency.

specs.subject: Citation-grounded report generation
specs.composition: A research question drives retrieval and evidence filtering; cited source fragments are organized into a compact evidence lattice, then a one-pass report composer emits claims linked back to citations and a verification panel.

specs.subject: Verified DOCA Agent Skills
specs.composition: A sealed skill package containing instructions, references and scripts moves through API-signature, hardware-compatibility and build-validation chambers before a preflight gate authorizes bounded execution with rollback.

specs.subject: Event-driven ambient agents with human approval
specs.composition: An event bus opens an isolated job state; policy and confidence gates route work either to bounded tool execution or a human-approval interrupt, after which the job resumes and writes a complete audit trail.
